message.content:
Perfect! I can see that Wi-Fi has been successfully turned on. The Wi-Fi toggle is now blue and in the ON position (checked), and I can see that there's an "AndroidWifi" network showing with "Limited connection" status, and it shows "Wifi signal full." This indicates that Wi-Fi is now active and scanning for networks. The task has been completed successfully.
finish(message="Wi-Fi has been successfully turned on! I can see the Wi-Fi toggle is now enabled (blue and in the ON position), and the device is showing available networks including "AndroidWifi" with a full signal. The task is complete - Wi-Fi is now active and ready to connect to networks.")
